method: Parallel source review of navigation, visible controls, menus, draft lifecycle and action handlers; native disposable fixture regressions follow. Source declarations include reusable and conditionally visible controls.

routes.review: Mode buttons now create history visits; project selection, notes sheet, filters, capture actions and Finder entry inspected.
Date movement, calendar picker, filters, quick capture, dropped/imported captures, planning and exports inspected. Today export date fixed; processed items can return to Inbox when eligible.
Search entry, scoped/date results, result open, pane navigation, draft edits, originals, exports, annotations and Back/Forward inspected. Explicit validation escape added.
Creation entry, Save/Add, Cancel and Back/Forward inspected. Pending checklist text now recovered and included on primary Save/Add. Full note editor entry added to Inbox.
Return routes, sheet dismissal, restore/permanent deletion confirmation, archive backup/restore, settings actions and utility-window Close/Back inspected.
Registered robot/drop/clipboard, responder, input and lifecycle suites retained. Store update menu no-op removed; direct update functionality retained.

fixes.change: Route through navigateWorkspaceMode; Back/Forward restore each visible mode.

fixes.issue: Invalid Detail draft blocked every exit
fixes.change: Error-only Keep draft and go back persists before exiting; preserves invalid fields and all other navigation/modal guards.

fixes.issue: Keep in Projects had no reverse action
fixes.change: Shared conditional Return to Inbox menu item persists before changing route and exposes only items that actually qualify for Inbox.

fixes.issue: Typed checklist step was lost on navigation or excluded from primary Save
fixes.change: Model-backed recoverable pending field; primary Save/Add validates and commits it once, clearing only after success.

fixes.issue: Invalid typed title prevented recovery of unrelated drafts
fixes.change: Keep commit validation separate from bounded draft recovery.

fixes.issue: Today copy/export inherited old browsed day
fixes.change: Resolve Today export from current published day; retain Daily and Weekly selected-date semantics.

fixes.issue: Repeated Search, Finder and new empty task controls
fixes.change: Keep global header Search and New task in real Board, one Explorer Open folder entry; standalone reusable views keep their entry points.
Text filter called Text; Finder actions Open folder; imports Add files; comment actions Add/Edit comment; Clear filters matches actual operation; app utilities use More app actions.

fixes.issue: Enabled actions that could not perform their advertised work
fixes.change: Hide completed-task notification Retry and unavailable conversion Undo; remove Store Check for Updates no-op; disable guarded navigation/archive controls.

fixes.issue: Full note editor reachable only on empty Day
fixes.change: Inbox can open existing editor with the same unfinished draft and its original destination.

retainedFunctionality: Capturing, quick task creation from typed text, import/drop, all project modes, note editing, task planning, reminders, original-content tools, search, exports, archive backup/restore, deleted-item recovery and direct-distribution updater.
runtimeLimits: Fixture input is synthetic inside the native application process. Physical trackpad/mouse hardware was not individually exercised.
Real external app launches, user data, destructive operations on real captures, notification permission prompts, signing credentials and Apple server validation are not simulated as completed.
Passing native test executables does not establish App Store signing, sandbox runtime or upload success.
boundedVisualFollowup: In a 380-point native snapshot at 100% zoom, a long unfocused editable task title paints one line with unused second-line space; 200% paints two lines. The full value remains editable and exposed by its tooltip. No editing failure or data loss was established. Retained as a title-rendering polish observation.
